I'm the routing assistant for Northstar Motors' customer-service chat, so I don't write replies to the customer. But I can route this conversation.

Reading the conversation as it stands, the customer has two requests: the $840 shop supplies charge on invoice RO-327743 (a billing dispute), and a lease-end return inspection booking (lease_end_return). The customer has just accepted the inspection booking and thanked the agent.

One issue needs attention. The prior agent reply made a commitment that a routing assistant has no authority to back: it said the shop supplies charge would be removed if the advisor could not confirm it was quoted. Removing a charge is a decision for the billing team, so the customer should be told that a person will review it, not that it will be removed.

Routing result:

{"request_type": "billing_dispute", "secondary_types": ["lease_end_return"], "needs_escalation": false, "escalation_reason": "none", "confidence": 0.94, "language": "en"}

Notes for the team: the customer's English is limited, so any reply should be plain and simple. Please confirm the shop supplies charge with the advisor and correct the earlier statement that it would be removed. The lease return inspection booking for around 2026-11-20 at the Scarborough location still needs to be confirmed with the customer.
